name: Ozonation and ozone-BAC filtration
principle: Published licensor practice (Xylem Wedeco): ozone generated from dry air or oxygen by silent corona discharge is dissolved in side-stream injection Contact tanks; O3 oxidises micropollutants, colour and pathogens (CT dose 0.5-3 mg/L), then residual ozone is quenched and water polished on biologically active carbon (BAC); biofilters then colonise with degrading biomass.

process_steps.name: Residual quench
equipment: quench chemicals or ozone destruction units

costs.metric: annual operation and maintenance cost, 1 MGD ozone disinfection system, excluding power
costs.basis: EPA 832-F-99-063 Table 2 (typical cost estimate for a 1 MGD system, source Champion Technology 1998): labour USD 12,000/yr plus other consumables USD 6,500/yr (filter replacements, compressor oil, spare dielectric); power demand 90 kW is listed but not costed. The USD 18,500 total is the sum of the two listed items and excludes power.

source.note: US EPA, Wastewater Technology Fact Sheet: Ozone Disinfection, EPA 832-F-99-063, September 1999, Table 2 typical cost estimate for a 1 MGD system (source Champion Technology, 1998)

gaps.item: total installed capital cost for an ozone disinfection system
gaps.reason: Annual O&M excluding power is now recorded. Table 2 lists capital components (oxygen feed gas and compressor USD 245,500; contact vessel USD 4,000-5,000; destruct unit USD 800-1,200; non-component USD 35,000; engineering USD 12,000-15,000; contingencies 30 percent) but states no total, and summing it would be a derivation the sheet does not make.
